newKindNeeds.inputs: (1) Monthly house price index, no gaps (FRED HPIPONM226N, NSA, Jan 1991=100). (2) Monthly rent CPI (FRED CUUR0000SEHA, NSA; '.' or empty = missing; the one interior missing month 2025-10 is filled with the geometric mean of its neighbours). (3) Weekly 30-year fixed rate in percent (FRED MORTGAGE30US). (4) Monthly 3-month T-bill rate in percent (FRED TB3MS), robustness only. Params: price, downShare, closingShare, ownerCostShare (per year, of current value), sellShare, termMonths, rentYieldAnchor, anchorMonth, firstStart, horizonsYears, mainYears, eras, robust.
newKindNeeds.computation: R(m) = mean of weekly rates dated in month m. For start s and horizon H (n = 12H months, e = s + n, needs R(s), HPI(s..e), CPI(s..e-1)): loan L = (1-down)P, x = R(s)/1200, p = L*x/(1-(1+x)^-360). Rent yield y(s) = Y*(CPI(s)/HPI(s))/(CPI(a)/HPI(a)). For k = 0..n-1 with m = s+k: V = P*HPI(m)/HPI(s); out = p + ownerCostShare/12*V; rent = y(s)*P/12*CPI(m)/CPI(s); pot += out - rent (pot starts at (down+closing)*P; in the T-bill variant pot *= 1 + TB3MS(m)/1200 after the deposit); balance = balance*(1+x) - p. Equity = (1-sellShare)*P*HPI(e)/HPI(s) - balance. Advantage = equity - pot. Shares = % of starts with advantage > 0; best/worst = max/min advantage, earliest on ties; eras by start month; rent-to-outlay = month-1 rent / month-1 out.
newKindNeeds.outputs: Per horizon: n, first, last, share_buyer_ahead, median_adv, best/worst start and advantage, n_renter_ahead. 10-year: best/worst rate, price change, rent change, equity, pot; era n/share/median; renter_first/last; yield median, max among renter wins, min/max, first, worst; robustness shares (T-bills, anchor 4% and 6%, fixed 5%); rent_to_outlay min and its month; today's month-1 outlay, rent and ratio at the latest complete rate month. Per-start table {start, rate, y, price change, rent change, equity, pot, advantage}.
newKindNeeds.invariants: Cash case: advantage = total rent - total buyer outlay - (down+closing)*P + equity (±1e-6). Balance after n < 360 payments is > 0 and decreasing in k. Advantage rises with rentYieldAnchor (share at 4% <= share at 5% <= share at 6%). T-bill variant advantage <= cash case advantage whenever the pot stays positive. Multiplying HPI or CPI by a constant changes nothing; all dollar outputs scale linearly with P. The ranking of today's rent-to-outlay against history does not depend on rentYieldAnchor. Every window ends at or before the last index month (no extrapolation).
newKindNeeds.dataNow: HPI to 2026-07; CPI rent to 2026-08 (2025-10 missing at source); PMMS weekly to 2026-10-08, latest complete month 2026-09; TB3MS to 2026-09. Retrieved 2026-10-11.
